policies.title: Comorian ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule places the Comoros in its Prior to Arrival visa category.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Comorian passport holder visiting Grenada; the schedule defines 'Prior To Arrival' as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
The Embassy's live visitor page confirms requirements depend on citizenship; work, study, residence, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment remain outside scope.
Admission remains subject to Grenada immigration control and the requirements of the competent mission or consulate.

policies.title: Comorian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly includes Comoros/Comoros Islands in its no-visa-required cohort for short visitor stays.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Comorian passport holder travelling to Panama as a short visitor; the Embassy states a maximum stay of three months for this cohort.
Passport validity, return travel, means of support, carrier checks and final admission remain separately required.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, special documents and other non-visitor purposes remain outside scope.

policies.title: Comorian ordinary passports: North Macedonia advance visitor visa
policies.summary: North Macedonia's live Foreign Ministry checker returns that Comorian foreign citizens need a visa, and its procedure requires pre-travel application through a competent representation.
conditions: The Foreign Ministry's nationality checker returns 'Needed' for the Comoros.
Separate third-country-document entry waivers, if applicable, are not an ordinary Comorian-passport baseline.
Work, residence, transit, special travel documents and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: North Macedonia visa application procedure
steps: Apply through the competent North Macedonian diplomatic-consular representation before the intended trip.
Submit the application no more than six months and at least 15 days before travel.
